cases.name: Mary Danbury
cases.about:
She worked at Kroger. Kroger co-workers and customers have said that Mary was a bright light who was always kind and always smiling. Her son Eugene Danbury said, “She was just one of the best people I know with one of the biggest hearts,” he said.

https://www.fox19.com/2021/12/22/milford-police-investigating-death-75-year-old-woman-homicide/
cases.narrative: Prosecutor Mark Tekulve said a knife and bat were recovered at the scene.
